chronology: Task8C Policy B authorized, followed by gated recovery

protocol.sampling: All eligible Standard FRM origination IDs; SHA256 namespace identifier-only rank, digest then ID, first min(N,eligible). No outcomes/credit/geography/history in selection.
protocol.source_release_adapter: Pinned official R47 July2026 31 origination/35 performance positions; fail closed on differences. Archive timestamps are not release proof.
protocol.horizon_origin: First observed reporting month, conditional on active known state. No inferred origination date. horizon h means h monthly intervals from that boundary.

horizon_support_rule.rule: Both risk support and known cause/status count must meet threshold; otherwise UNSUPPORTED. No future outcomes extrapolated.

protocol.endpoint_count_rule: First observed default/payoff/administrative/ambiguous category across sorted complete retained source history; active_or_unknown otherwise, exactly as Task4/6 descriptive endpoints. Distinct from gap/unknown-censored analytical follow-up.
protocol.risk_rule: First contiguous active known prefix from first observed month through first clinical endpoint, ambiguity, admin, unknown or gap. Never re-enter. Preserve/quarantine later raw rows. Duplicate months stop analytical prefix.
future_constraints: national macro replacing unrestricted period FE
protocol.record_authorization: User supplied seven local Standard archives in response to explicit official-source acquisition instructions; no authentication automated; exact download times unknown.
protocol.authorization: Policy B only for A1-A4. Any additional origination anomaly or selected-performance convention fails closed.

components.eligible_universe_status: inherited 2010 sample; full universe not reconstructed

dataset_manifest.key_definition: archive_vintage:immutable source facility ID; no borrower uniqueness claim

age_period_support.scope: Inherited analytical-prefix support includes terminal/censor boundary rows; not pure active exposure
age_period_support.density_interpretation: Descriptive; includes structurally infeasible grid cells, not a scientific support threshold
age_period_support.assessment: Completed seven-vintage support can inform the preferred constrained predictive design; regime coverage, macro availability, censoring and evaluation gates remain required. Multiple occupied cells do not establish unrestricted APC identification.

first_payment_proxy_age_period_support.scope: Nonnegative elapsed months since immutable first payment; analytical-prefix rows including endpoint/censor boundaries, not exact origination age

synthetic.scope: Exact-clock illustration; does not assert exact mortgage origination month

empirical_proxy.scope: First-payment proxy clocks; not exact origination date or provider age

future_constraints: national macro replacing unrestricted period FE

2020.definition: analytical_prefix=True and event_category=none; distinct facilities within vintage/year

2021.definition: analytical_prefix=True and event_category=none; distinct facilities within vintage/year

limitations: Current-release retrospective disclosure: operational knowledge time and historical revisions remain unverified.
ZIP timestamps and matching field counts do not independently attest the exact source release.
Facility identity is not borrower identity; cross-facility or cross-vintage borrower independence is not established.
First payment month is not exact origination or accounting recognition; no fabricated daily dates or exact DPD.
Monthly research default is a proxy; payoff includes maturity, not uniquely voluntary prepayment.
Loss amounts are signed aggregate disclosures, not timed recovery cash flows, accounting LGD or ECL.
Modification and assistance disclosures do not identify every intervention or pandemic forbearance.
Natural follow-up is unequal; no outcome extrapolation, adaptive replacement or global truncation.
Overlap does not identify unrestricted age, period and cohort effects or causal macro coefficients.
Source semantics for A1-A4 remain unresolved; exact-record eligibility exclusion does not establish provider error or harmlessness.
Inherited 2010 frozen sample has no reconstructed full eligible-universe count; do not present identifier census as full eligibility certification.
Source-wide structural performance column checks; semantic typing covers selected histories, not every unselected performance record.

Provider-reported age diverges from the immutable first-payment elapsed clock on some histories. Both support matrices are retained separately; no reset mechanism is inferred and no provider age is rewritten. Broad provider-age coverage does not establish original-duration overlap.
next_task: Point-in-time macro acquisition and feature engineering, constrained to demonstrated periods/horizons and APC restrictions
